changelog:
VexZygisk v2.1.0

- Zygisk Next support: modules written against the Zygisk Next API (recent LSPosed builds among them) can load, with per-target resolution and optional companions
- Module libraries travel as memfds, so unprivileged targets can load them without touching the modules' own mode and SELinux label
- Zygisk and Zygisk Next modules are served side by side, matching NyaZygisk
- Material 3 WebUI redesign of the home and modules pages
- Module list now shows the companion flag and per-module targets
- Fixed the startup spinner getting stuck on the M3 loader and a file-descriptor leak in GetModuleDir
